source_review.notes: Checked all ten final NASA and NIST references on 2026-08-31; every URL returned HTTP 200. Reviewed NASA Configuration Management, Decision Analysis, Technical Risk/Requirements/Interface Management, Technical Assessment, Product Verification and Validation, NIST SP 800-128 security impact analysis, and NPR 7123.1B. NASA and NIST institutional scopes are explicit and principles are presented as requiring domain tailoring.

evidence: Reviewed typed graph G=(V,E,tau), seed set, recursive candidate closure, and relation-policy qualification.
Reviewed per-candidate impact record containing path, consequence, severity, likelihood, uncertainty, evidence, action, owner, and effectivity.
Reviewed change proposal tuple, distinction between proposed and observed configuration, and evidence-claim configuration assumptions.
Confirmed candidate closure is parameterized by graph version and traversal policy and is never equated with material impacts.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation consistently separates discovered candidates, evaluated consequences, evidence applicability, effectivity, and authorization.

evidence: Executed change-impact-closure-fixture under python3 with exact output in artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-085/report.json.
Recomputed ten declared directed edges across five source nodes.
Confirmed one seed reaches nine unique downstream candidates despite one converging relationship.
Confirmed five candidates have no declared outgoing edge and appear in the exact terminal list.
Recomputed Exercise 2 disposition coverage as 8/9=88.888...%.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Graph counts and coverage measure declared workflow structure only; they do not measure completeness, severity, risk reduction, semantics, evidence quality, or approval readiness.

evidence: Confirmed reachability implies only a candidate for examination, not material impact or severity.
Confirmed non-reachability implies no impact only under complete/correct graph and traversal assumptions that the chapter does not claim.
Confirmed unchanged requirement text does not entail unchanged purpose, margin, hazard, evidence, support, or operational value.
Confirmed approval does not entail implementation, verification, observed effectivity, baseline update, or closure.
Confirmed evidence transfer is proposition- and configuration-specific rather than proportional to unchanged file count.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Implication limits and counterexamples prevent static dependency output or risk scores from becoming false proof.

evidence: Challenged missing/stale/wrong-direction relationships, renamed semantics, hidden runtime dependencies, supplier and physical processes, human work, organizational authority, and external services.
Challenged direct/indirect/emergent/common-cause/cumulative impacts, shared margins, mixed versions, partial/offline populations, spares, repairs, disaster recovery, and unsupported variants.

Challenged additive interfaces, stored/in-flight data, compiler-only changes, tool/test configuration, migration idempotence, rollback incompatibility, physical irreversibility, and premature old-state retirement.
Challenged arbitrary numeric scoring, compensatory decisions across veto constraints, false no-impact claims, emergency shortcuts, stale inventories, and approval/merge/deployment as false closure.
Reviewed all ten examples and five complete answers for assumptions, intermediate reasoning, evidence limitations, uncertainty, effectivity, and bounded conclusions.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Real CIA requires applicable systems, domain/product, software/data/platform, interface, supply, human-factors, operations, safety/security/privacy, V&V, contractual/regulatory, records, and technical-authority expertise.

evidence: Confirmed exact identified before/proposed states, rationale, alternatives, assumptions, urgency, reversibility, and expected benefit precede analysis.
Confirmed discovery combines bidirectional typed traces with independent models, observations, history, physical inspection, scenarios, and expertise.
Confirmed every candidate receives affected, unaffected-with-rationale, conditional, unknown, or owned out-of-scope disposition.
Confirmed evidence is reassessed claim by claim with configuration, tools, data, procedures, environment, anomalies, and limitations.
Confirmed implementation order, coexistence, effectivity, V&V, monitoring, communication, abort/recovery, and old-state disposition are analyzed before authorization.
Confirmed implementation differences, new dependencies, anomalies, and violated assumptions reopen analysis before observed closure.
invariant_checking.notes: No diff, graph, checklist, test count, risk score, approval, merge, deployment percentage, or rollback artifact is treated as sufficient alone.

proof_review.notes: No formal proof or theorem requires proof review; recursive closure is a standard finite graph mechanism used as a bounded fixture.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is labeled or presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: Executable output is labeled declared_graph_reachability_only.
Fixture limitations disclaim hidden dependencies, edge semantics, material consequence, severity, uncertainty, evidence validity, effectivity, interactions, and authorization.
Examples and exercises are synthetic teaching cases, not actual impact assessments, safety decisions, security authorizations, supplier approvals, or regulated submissions.
Official sources are attributed without claiming NASA or NIST review, approval, or endorsement of this chapter.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Synthetic reachability, source-backed guidance, internal review, domain analysis, technical authority, and operational authorization remain distinct.

conceptual_review.notes: Internal conceptual review checked exact change framing, typed bidirectional search, candidate-versus-consequence distinctions, multiple discovery lenses, impact domains, effectivity, interactions, uncertainty, alternatives, evidence invalidation, transition design, and observed closure.

practitioner_review.notes: Internal practitioner-oriented review checked physical/software/data/platform changes, interfaces, supply/lots, humans/procedures, fleets/sites/spares, emergency paths, migration/coexistence, monitoring, rollback/forward recovery, cumulative releases, records, metrics, and authority.

pedagogical_review.notes: Internal pedagogical review confirmed progression from decision framing and change seeds through discovery, disposition, domain consequence, evidence, effectivity, transition, authorization, and closure. Ten examples and five complete solutions cover hardware, APIs, compilers, data, platforms, cumulative changes, security, human work, fleets, and obsolescence.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external NASA/NIST expert, systems/domain engineer, configuration manager, architect, interface owner, supplier/manufacturer, software/data/platform owner, human-factors specialist, operator/maintainer, safety/security/privacy authority, V&V authority, regulator/customer, records/legal authority, auditor, or other external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
